data.one_liner: Dart client for Sanity.io with GROQ queries and live updates
data.what_it_does: Provides a type‑safe way to execute GROQ queries against Sanity.io’s HTTP API. It also supports live data streams, CDN usage, and image URL building.
avoid_when: Using older Dart/Flutter versions (requires Dart 3.14+ and Flutter 3.50+)
Projects that already use a different Sanity client
strengths: Strong type safety for queries and responses
Built‑in live streaming with automatic reconnects
Flexible image URL builder and external service support
weaknesses: Breaking changes in v2.0.0 may need migration
data.setup_notes: Add sanity_client to pubspec.yaml. No build_runner or codegen required.
